title: 有馬記念の後に・変わらない強さ

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Hishi Amazon loses to Narita Brian at the Arima Kinen. The onlooking crowd wonders if she can ever outdo the Beast.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, she refuses to give up. She vows to get a proper rematch against Narita Brian at the Arima Kinen next year.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After talking it over, we decide to set the Osaka Hai as our next goal, and it's going to be first place or bust!
